BiblicalUsage: Psalms 68:6 is the word's only appearance, and the King James Version renders it "chains": God "bringeth out those which are bound with chains." The Hebrew word itself speaks of prosperity and freedom, so the verse pictures God leading His bound people out into a broad, free place.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced the verse says what the word means: God does not only release His people, He brings them out into prosperity, and the chains are left behind.
